areasText: We are dedicated to transforming your home for a more sustainable, all-electric future. We partner with experienced local tradesmen to ensure every installation exceeds Australian standards and regulations.
whyParagraphs: We specialise in all-electric homes and sustainable living. Our experienced residential electrician services are designed to make your Melbourne home more energy-efficient, and we work with other local tradesmen to help customers disconnect from gas.
We can help you access government rebates without having to deal with wait-lists or pushy salespeople. You connect directly with the skilled tradespeople who will handle your installation.

body: Ben and the team installed my evnex charger for me, lovely blokes and did a great job. Will definitely have them back out for future electrical work.
These guys are fantastic! Made a stressful problem easy for me and very reasonable fees.
Excellent install and service by Revelectrical. Arrived on time, very polite and clean install of the EV charger.

I highly recommend RevElectrical. Ben installed my Evnex EV charger, and I couldn't be happier with the service. He was professional, friendly, punctual, and completed the installation to a very high standard. His workmanship was excellent, and he took the time to make sure everything was working perfectly before he left. The whole process was smooth and hassle-free.

The guys at revelectrical did a great installation, we're very happy with their work! They arrived on time, communicated well and helped with understanding the new setup. They're just what the west needs, when it comes to degasification and going electric, they get it!

We had a charger installed, an Evnex E2 Core for the Atto 2. Superb job, nicely done, even arranged for a plaster hiccup to be fixed same day. Also installed a surge protector in the fuse box to protect all appliances. Both times on time, efficient, good value and great guys, highly recommend.

I purchased an EVNEX Smart Charger for my EV, and Ben is their authorized electrician to do these installs in my area. He did an excellent job and answered all my questions patiently. He noticed that my switchboard needed an upgrade and suggested some new RCBOs. Ben wasn't pushy at all.
Very professional. On time and very easy seamless overall process. Highly recommended.
Great guys, really friendly and genuine. Did a fantastic job installing the evnex e2 plus charger. Highly recommend them.
